core.label: ABCA core platform
core.remediation: Deploy ABCA to a Region where both AgentCore Runtime and AgentCore Memory are available.

slack.label: Slack
slack.description: Slack App: /bgagent slash command, mentions, DMs and task notifications.
slack.remediation: Slack uses only Regional services that ABCA core already requires.

linear.label: Linear
linear.description: Linear webhook intake, epic orchestration and issue status updates.
linear.remediation: Linear uses only Regional services that ABCA core already requires.

jira.label: Jira
jira.description: Jira Cloud webhook intake, epic orchestration and issue status updates.
jira.remediation: Jira uses only Regional services that ABCA core already requires.

deployPreviewScreenshots.label: Deploy-preview screenshots
deployPreviewScreenshots.description: GitHub deployment_status webhook that screenshots preview deploys with AgentCore Browser.
deployPreviewScreenshots.remediation: Choose a Region where AgentCore Built-in Tools are available, or disable deploy-preview screenshots: set features.deployPreviewScreenshots to false in abca.deployment.json, pass -c enableDeployPreviewScreenshots=false, or run bgagent setup.

agentRegistry.label: AWS Agent Registry
agentRegistry.description: Central registry for Blueprint MCP servers, skills and Cedar policy modules (ADR-022).
agentRegistry.remediation: Choose one of the supported Regions, or disable the Agent Registry: set features.agentRegistry to false in abca.deployment.json, pass -c enableAgentRegistry=false, or run bgagent setup.

toolGateway.label: Tool Gateway
toolGateway.description: AgentCore Gateway federating platform MCP tools to the agent (ADR-019, proposed).
toolGateway.remediation: Choose a Region where AgentCore Gateway is available, or disable the Tool Gateway: set features.toolGateway to false in abca.deployment.json, pass -c enableToolGateway=false, or run bgagent setup.
